note: Labelled fixtures for the deterministic rule engine. Every expected finding is something a brand reviewer would agree is a real problem; every document with an empty expectation is a false-positive guard. Add cases here before changing a rule's behaviour.

voice: Write in plain, confident English. Short sentences, no hype.
Always address the reader as "you"; never use "we" to mean the customer.
accessibility: Every image must carry descriptive alt text of at least five words.
Text must reach a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background.
logo: Use only the approved primary logo from the brand kit. Never recolour it.
claims: Numbers and superlatives must appear in the approved facts before publishing.

documents.note: One banned term and one preferred term in the same paragraph.
